title: ADAC BMW i5 test — 30 January 2025
observation: ADAC describes an instrumented i5 eDrive40 test and a broader review of the 5 Series electric variants. The test is a source for condition-specific journey and refinement questions.
use: German test context, not a US customer sample or a successor target. Do not compare its test results directly with a manufacturer specification under different conditions.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA — 2026 EQE 320 4MATIC specifications
observation: The manufacturer lists electric-navigation support and distinguishes standard dual-zone climate control from optional four-zone climate control for this US sedan.
use: A plausible premium-electric-sedan comparator for feature packaging and trip-support questions. Manufacturer availability does not establish customer preference, real-world reliability or superiority over BMW. Relevant to charging/range, controls and comfort proposals only as context.

title: IEA Global EV Outlook 2026 — published 20 May 2026
observation: The report separates historical observations from projections and covers charging infrastructure and software/AI technology developments.
use: Use multiple EV and charging scenarios when reviewing the 2029-2031 charging proposal. No numeric US adoption forecast or BMW-specific demand rating is imported from the overview.
